# flightdeck_teamspace_member (Resource)

Puts a member of the workspace on a Flightdeck teamspace. Being on a team grants no access to anything; project access is `flightdeck_project_member`.

Any member of the workspace except a guest can add and remove a team's members. Adding a user who is already on the team adopts that membership rather than failing, so destroying this resource takes them off the team even if they were added some other way. Changing either id replaces the membership.

Import with `<teamspace_id>/<user_id>`: `terraform import flightdeck_teamspace_member.alex 12/7`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "flightdeck_teamspace" "platform" {
  name = "Platform"
}

data "flightdeck_workspace_member" "alex" {
  email = "alex@example.com"
}

resource "flightdeck_teamspace_member" "alex" {
  teamspace_id = flightdeck_teamspace.platform.id
  user_id      = data.flightdeck_workspace_member.alex.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `teamspace_id` (Number) Id of the teamspace. Changing it replaces the membership.
- `user_id` (Number) User id of a member of the workspace, which a `flightdeck_workspace_member` data source resolves from an email address. Changing it replaces the membership.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<teamspace_id>/<user_id>`, the import id. A membership has no id of its own.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with <teamspace_id>/<user_id>.
terraform import flightdeck_teamspace_member.alex 12/7
```
